mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases over 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic output and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 70% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and a healthy labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and healthy labor market
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, but S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 month-over-month signals strong job growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 MoM and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: accommodative monetary policy with economic growth
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and GDPC1 increases simultaneously, but S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
